storyInfo: At the annual Winter Ball, Natalya meets many kinds of nobles as she probes for information alone. While the nobles bicker over politics, they find themselves surrounded by protesting students.

attributes.content: Only candles lighting the corridors. Is the palace cutting back power usage too?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: His Imperial Majesty wishes to share the conserved energy with the people.
attributes.name: Attentive Servant

attributes.content: Rest assured, this is simply a pragmatic measure of frugality. Life in the palace has not been affected, nor has this year's Winter Ball.
attributes.name: Attentive Servant

attributes.content: Here we are. May I take your coat, Miss Rostova?
attributes.name: Attentive Servant

attributes.content: That's very kind of you.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: It is my duty.
attributes.name: Attentive Servant

attributes.content: So bright...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I will take my leave, then.
attributes.name: Attentive Servant

attributes.content: One moment. I have some questions—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: —Natashenka?
attributes.name: Noblewoman

attributes.content: Countess Vorontsova?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Gosudar-batyushka... it's really you, poor girl!
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: The noblewoman hurriedly approaches Rosa, so excited she can hardly maintain her aristocratic demeanor.
She grabs Rosa's arm tightly, as though confirming she has not seen a ghost.
Natashenka... oh, I'm so glad to see you... alive and well...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: It broke my heart to hear what happened in Chernobog. Why would fate be so cruel to such a kind family?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Thank you for your sympathy. We lost some property, but it's nothing compared to the safety of the family... and anyway, it's all in the past.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Yes, yes, let us leave all the painful memories in the past... you have no idea how glad I was to read your letter that you were coming to Deity Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I wish you could enjoy a peaceful time here, but the capital is hardly a peaceful place these days.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Malcontents and ingrates everywhere—as though the troubles stirred by those insolent military brutes were not enough, now unruly commoners want to turn Deity Grypherburg upside-down.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Oh, look at me, this is no way to talk to the daughter of an old friend that I haven't seen in years. You've only just gotten back, of course you have no idea! I'm afraid I'm always on edge these days, I hardly get any sleep at night.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Not at all. I'm glad you're sharing the news with me.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You're a good girl, but this is not a good time to talk of such things.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Is your mother well, Natashenka? What about your father, Andrey?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: If he's in the capital without saying a word, sending you alone to the Winter Ball...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I suppose I've been a poor friend, and allowed our families to drift apart.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Countess, that's not it at all. Father asked me to send you his regards if I saw you, and to beg your pardon for falling out of touch.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: And of course, I do not need to tell you that you are Mother's best friend, but the House of Rostov is focusing our full attention on what assets we have left in the Central Governorate.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: 'We must not lose any more prestige,' and I regret to say... they are fully occupied, for the time being.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I understand, but you should say, 'Therefore, I am here.'
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Look at you, a proper young lady all grown up. You are a perfect representative of the House of Rostov!
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I must say, you show better manners and dignity than many native Grypherburgers... I'm sure the Rostov name will be known throughout the capital before long.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: No... I still have much to learn.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Speaking of which, I would very much like to ask about the present situation...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Have patience, young Natashenka. I understand your unease, but this is not something that can be explained in a few words.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Learn to observe with your own eyes. There is no better opportunity than this. What you should do now, is go enjoy the Winter Ball.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Until His Majesty arrives, set aside all the troubling questions, all the answers you eagerly seek, and all the wild theories about what the future holds. Enjoy the present.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Dance, laugh, do as youth ought to.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: And if a young officer catches your eye, I will stake my reputation to be your matchmaker, for the sake of your mother, even if it's stubborn old Bolkonsky's—
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Enjoy the peace of His Majesty's protection. It is a privilege for those of us who live here in the capital, those of us who are loyal.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: You must learn this in order to fully integrate yourself, Natashenka.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.text: '...You must learn this in order to fully integrate yourself.'

attributes.content: ...The miners are still hungry. Even in Grypherburg, the residents of Odoyev Raion can no longer afford heating, while Katorga Raion has seen power and heat cut completely upon work stoppage.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: But for them, the show must go on.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: I don't understand... didn't that person say His Majesty is reducing the palace's electricity use? What happened to the energy conserved? Why—
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: This is all such nonsense. Dealing with big shots is such a hassle.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Is Rosa gonna be okay in there?
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: Natalya spoke to us a few days before the Student Assembly general meeting about going into the ball as the scion of House Rostov to gather information.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Certain things are known only to the aristocracy, after all. And more information never hurts, regardless of where it comes from.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Sonya believes she can do it, and I have no reason to object. The contents of these conversations are as expected. Things seem to be going smoothly so far, and the audio feed is clear.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: We have to thank that student they call Botani for this. Her equipment has worked out even better than I hoped.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: All we need to do is to cooperate with the protestors and follow the plan.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Zima's waving at us! We should go to her.
attributes.name: Gummy

attributes.content: I think she's talked things over with the others. We'll pack up and head over.
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Leto, are you staying here or...?
attributes.name: Istina

attributes.content: Shh, gimme a sec.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Something's happening.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I thought this year's Winter Ball would be cancelled...
attributes.name: Worried Noble

attributes.content: Those insolent traitors are attempting to coerce His Imperial Majesty by force of arms. But I'm not sure how the tsar intends to deal with them...
attributes.name: Worried Noble

attributes.content: All the more important that we hold our heads high and continue doing what we must. His Imperial Majesty has both courage and vision.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: This is the strongest possible response. It proves that there is nothing to be feared from the chaos, that we will not be beaten by traitors who have already failed once.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: As for those who do not see clearly, and choose to stand with the traitors... we will place flowers on their graves, this time next year.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: Look out!
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: —I'm sorry—
You have ruined not only the young lady's dress, but also a cup of fine wine... sudar'.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: I'm so sorry! Please forgive the offense, Duchess Volkina—
You did not offend me, but you should apologize to the young lady whose dress you have soiled.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: Erm, I apologize, baryshnya...
It's alright.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Who let this buffoon in?
attributes.name: Worried Noble

attributes.content: He could hardly be a nameless commoner if the servants let him in. What is your name?
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: Ah! Please call me Pavlovich, a humble deputy of the Duma. I was recently appointed magistrate by His Imperial Majesty, serving as special representative for recent matters in Katorga Raion—
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: A representative of Katorga Raion? Ah, I remember now.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: You know me? I'm honored!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Of course, of course. I heard the State Council was having difficulty finding someone to deal with the Katorga problem. I'm sure you must be a remarkable talent, if the responsibility has fallen upon your shoulders.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: I would have sent someone to congratulate you, if I was not busy arranging winter supplies for the Second Army.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: You flatter me, Your Grace... I have been serving in Katorga for two months now.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: In fact, I do not know why I was given such an important responsibility, but I certainly would not dream of disappointing His Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: As you may know, Katorga Raion is not as worthless as people think. All this old industrial district needs is an opportunity to revitalize itself...
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: (Whisper) Why have I never heard of him?
attributes.name: Worried Noble

attributes.content: Perhaps you've been spending too much time on your luxurious estate and grown out of touch with the personnel movements of the central government. At least read a few newspapers while you sit on your rocking chair in your garden.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: All the news does is make one more troubled.
attributes.name: Worried Noble

attributes.content: Of course, I am unworthy of Your Serenity's attention, Count Golitsyn—I understand that this has been an exemplary year for your winery, and you must be very busy...
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: Enough flattery. I believe you still owe this young lady a formal apology.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: What is your name, baryshnya?
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: I am Natalya Rostova, Your Grace.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Rostova? I am not familiar with the name...
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: Neither am I.
attributes.name: Worried Noble

attributes.content: Ah! Your father must be Count Andrey Rostov of Chernobog!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: You know of my father?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Of course! His Serenity demonstrated such foresight when he pulled out from Chernobog just in time, narrowly avoiding complete ruin!
attributes.name: Pavlovich

attributes.content: ...That's all in the past now.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I see you are surprisingly... knowledgeable, Gospodin Pavlovich.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: But you ought to get changed, young lady. Even the best wine was not made to be tasted by silk.
attributes.name: Proud Noble

attributes.content: Yes, spasibo...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Rosa hurries away from the embarrassing scene. She can still hear the excited conversation going on behind her as she leaves.
Duchess Volkina! I hear that you oppose the motion to decommission Katorga Raion. I am naturally of the same mind...
attributes.name: Flattering Voice

attributes.content: ...The factories are still...
attributes.name: Flattering Voice

attributes.content: ...Perhaps we can work together...
attributes.name: Flattering Voice

attributes.content: ...Watch your words, Melnikov. Not even His Imperial Majesty has made an official statement on the events of the Far North.
attributes.name: Stern Noble

attributes.content: You misunderstand. I am not leveling an accusation towards you or the Grand Duchess.
attributes.name: Arrogant Noble

attributes.content: However, I have long expressed concerns about Breskenoy, long before Yelizaveta's transgressions in the Far North, yet your camp unanimously swore to His Imperial Majesty that her loyalty should not be questioned.
attributes.name: Arrogant Noble

attributes.content: You, and every single member of the old guard, have betrayed the trust of the State Council and His Imperial Majesty.
attributes.name: Arrogant Noble

attributes.content: Then I look forward to your speech at the hearing. You would do well not to change a single word, that everyone might hear how you slander the foundations of our empire.
attributes.name: Stern Noble

attributes.content: There is no need to wait until then.
attributes.name: Arrogant Noble

attributes.content: I will expose your crimes to His Imperial Majesty when he attends tonight's ball!
attributes.name: Arrogant Noble

attributes.content: The angry shouting has drawn the attention of the crowd. Several servants hurry to the scene, trying to placate the angry aristocrat.
Rosa pulls on her sleeves to ward off the cold, though the fireplaces in the ballroom burn hotter than anywhere else in Ursus, and the heat is always on.
A servant is replacing the fragrance. The smell of citron and neroli cover up the stinging scent of evaporating alcohol. Rosa lets out a long sigh.
Are you alright, Natashenka? Have you not yet found an appropriate conversation partner?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Oh dear, what happened to your dress? Did someone insult you? Give me a name, and I will teach them a lesson!
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Please, Countess, there is no need to be angry. It's a mark of honor for assisting a noble lady.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You have a heart of gold, my child, but please, take care of your own safety first next time. Who knows what those sycophants might do?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I appreciate your concern, but that was the most interesting thing to happen to me tonight.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Most of what I've heard has to do with the Grand Duchess. I tried to understand and ask questions, but I lack the necessary knowledge to continue the conversation.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: This is why your parents sent you to Grypherburg, my dear Natashenka.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I have seen many young ladies give their souls to cooks, tailors, and doctors, but not the great people who write laws, quell rebellions, and set taxes...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Even if they are always caring about us.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I understand, but today I'm simply the heir of a humble count with naught but a few small holdings in the Central Governorate. How might I catch a gaze that these busy lords only occasionally cast?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: ...I should make myself clearer, since you're my old friend's only daughter.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Politics is a part of all our lives. No one is immune, especially not those upon whom a title of nobility has conferred a heavy responsibility.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Are these responsibilities carried out by engaging in small talk in a place like this?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Natashenka...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: You misunderstand the reason we talk here. These words are not necessarily announcements of measures certain to be implemented, nor do they necessarily represent our true views.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Then... why?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: To fit in. To know which people to avoid, and which to befriend.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: One signature may be all it takes to rebuild your parents' fortune, to keep your children out of the trenches, to allow your friends to sleep soundly on a grand estate.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Do not think you can avoid their gazes by indulging in pleasure. It will only cause those gazes to harden, and permit no question.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: That is how a highly effective social scene operates, Natashenka.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: ...Looks like I still have much to learn.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: And time is the one thing that young people have aplenty.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: (Whisper) It's the Chairman—
attributes.name: Noble A

attributes.content: And Vice Chairman Vasily Gorchikov! This is a rare sight. They are hardly ever seen together outside of the State Council...
attributes.name: Noble B

attributes.content: The Chairman is rarely seen at the balls, but His Imperial Majesty has not yet arrived... is this a sign?
attributes.name: Noble A

attributes.content: Perhaps they are trying to present a picture of calm.
attributes.name: Noble B

attributes.content: It may be too late for that.
attributes.name: Noble A

attributes.content: Those two...?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: All eyes are on the two men who just entered. The crowd parts to allow them to proceed to the middle of the hall.
The greetings from the crowd are loud, though their sincerity is uncertain.
Rosa carefully observes the pair from the crowd.
The black-haired man walks through the crowd in silence, not the slightest emotion on his face. His gaze is firm, but clearly fatigued, fixed on the empty space in front of him.
The man whom they call Vice Chairman walks behind the black-haired man who is a head shorter than he is, respectfully keeping a short distance while nodding and smiling in response to the crowd.
...The blonde one is Duke Vasily Gorshkov, colonel-in-chief of the Imperial Guard, and executive Vice Chairman of the State Council.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: (Whisper) And the black-haired one in front of him is—
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Chairman Islam Witte.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Yes... everyone in Grypherburg should recognize him.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Actually, I watched the Speech at the Inauguration Ceremony of the Tulskaya Special Technical School on the intercity net. It was an impressive speech, concise and sincere.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Ah, the intercity net... I will never understand such newfangled things.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Go before them, Natashenka. Listen to what these people talk about. This is a learning opportunity.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Yes, Countess, I will—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: The sharp sound of glass cracking interrupts the cheerful conversations around the hall, as everyone looks around for its source.
Count Osadchy, are you feeling unwell?
attributes.name: Noble A

attributes.content: ...No, no! It's them! They're downstairs!
attributes.name: Noble B

attributes.content: What? Who turned off the lights—power outage?
attributes.name: Noble A

attributes.content: The palace wouldn't lose power just like this! It must be the mob—
attributes.name: Noble B

attributes.content: Are the duty officers of the palace so incompetent they can't even maintain an electrical switch—
attributes.name: Noble A

attributes.content: ...Look outside!
attributes.name: Noble B

attributes.content: There's a mob right outside the window!
attributes.name: Noble B
